integrity: Hyperdistance is computed directly from its definition by reducing the center optimization to cyclic index distance. The global maximum is proved to occur at the largest admissible odd separation: every even separation is dominated by the preceding odd one, and the odd-separation sequence is strictly increasing. The packaged exhaustive checker is a finite replay aid only.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns finite regular vertex samples of a Euclidean circle with ambient chord distance. It does not cover intrinsic polygon-boundary metrics, irregular cyclic samples, or higher-dimensional spherical configurations.
title: Exact convexity gap of regular polygon vertex sets
